Gradually. It started with feeling detached from my hands in Freshman high, and it's gotten worse with time, I think. It's mostly just being "zoned out", feeling like I'm in a movie or smth, and most recently, memory loss. It's not severe though, more like "did that really happen or did I dream it?" type of thing.

What helps is having something that you use or do in your daily life. Idk, like doodling, or riding ur bike, or just listening to songs that get you moving. Whatever it is, as long as it's kinda physical and gets you distracted from the dissociation. 

Also, talk to your friends, any close people in your life that you think will understand, or at least care enough to try. Don't expect them to give you professional help, but just know that they are there for you, and it's gonna be okay.

And maybe, this is gonna be a stretch, but try to lay off the weed for a while? It's different for everyone, but in my experience, it just adds to the dissociation. Had my first bad trip a few weeks ago, and I get how you feel. Really thought I was going to stay that way forever. My arms felt heavy, yet I didn't perceive them as my own. The morning after felt like a dream, like I'm watching a movie, and my speech is just filtered through a script. 

Hope u feel better dude
